headline: One team for the whole event: website, email, paid media, and social — 2.2× traffic, 4× reach, and 10× engagement by race weekend.
cardHeadline: Five months of full-service digital: 2.2× website traffic, 4× total reach, and 10× engagement for race weekend.

metrics.desc: Website sessions multiplied over the five-month engagement.
Combined organic and paid reach across all channels.
Interactions across social content, up tenfold.

overview.challenge: A destination triathlon lives or dies by the weeks before race day. Bintan Triathlon needed one partner to own the full digital journey — from the first time an athlete hears about the race to the moment they register, show up, and share it — on a fixed, immovable deadline.
overview.solution: Go Mobile ran the event's entire digital operation as a full-service partner: we built the website, ran email marketing, managed paid advertising, and operated social media — and backed it with event documentation, asset creation, and regular performance reporting, from February to June 2024.
overview.result: By race weekend, website traffic had grown 2.2×, total reach 4×, and engagement 10×, with net follower growth of +14.8%. Email marketing reached a 54% open rate with an 11% click-through rate — and every workstream was documented and reported back as it happened.

approachHeading.title: Everything the event needed, under one roof.

approach.title: Website & Lead Generation
approach.desc: We developed the event's website framework and design from scratch, built as a lead-generation engine: every page engineered to move visitors toward registration.

approach.title: Email Marketing
approach.desc: Lifecycle email kept athletes moving from interest to start line — announcements, registration pushes, and race-week logistics. The program reached a 54% open rate with an 11% click-through rate.

approach.title: Paid Media & Social
approach.desc: Paid campaigns and always-on social content ran side by side, with visual creative A/B testing to find what made athletes stop scrolling — driving 4× reach and 10× engagement growth.

approach.title: Content, Documentation & Reporting
approach.desc: Our team produced the event's creative assets, documented the event itself, and delivered performance reports throughout — so the organisers always knew what was working.

headline: Nineteen months of always-on mobile user acquisition cut cost per action by 52.5% — while installs kept compounding past 495K.
cardHeadline: Nineteen months of always-on mobile user acquisition cut cost per action by 52.5% while driving 495K+ installs.

metrics.desc: Cost per action reduced over the life of the campaign.
App installs delivered across the engagement.
Users progressing to key in-app events after install.
Average month-on-month performance gain across the campaign.

overview.challenge: Digital banks win on adoption, and adoption is a performance problem: acquire users at an efficient cost, and make sure they don't stop at the install. Bank Jago needed sustained, improving user acquisition — not a one-quarter spike.
overview.solution: We ran a long-term mobile marketing program built around Bank Jago's promotional offers, spanning paid campaigns and OEM device channels, with creative-level optimization guided by MMP data — improving month over month for nineteen consecutive months.
overview.result: Over 19 months, cost per action fell 52.5% while the campaign delivered 495K+ installs, with 16.48% of users progressing to key in-app events and an average 4.91% month-on-month improvement — proof that always-on beats bursts.

approach.title: Offer-led messaging
approach.desc: Bank Jago's promotional offers were matched to the audiences most likely to act on them, so every campaign led with a reason to open an account.

approach.title: OEM device channels
approach.desc: Beyond paid media, we used OEM channels to put the app on devices from the moment of purchase — reaching users before the app-store battle even starts.

approach.title: Category education
approach.desc: Creative consistently promoted the benefits of digital banking itself, growing the category while growing the brand.

approach.title: Creative-level optimization
approach.desc: Campaigns were optimized at the individual-creative level, with raw MMP data analysed continuously to guide budget and creative decisions.

headline: No paid installs, no shortcuts: five months of app store optimization lifted organic installs 31% and took the store rating from 3.4 to 4.8.
period: 5-MONTH PROGRAM · APP STORE OPTIMIZATION · ORGANIC ONLY
cardHeadline: Five months of app store optimization lifted organic installs 31% and took the store rating from 3.4 to 4.8.

metrics.desc: Install growth from organic store traffic alone.
App rating at program start vs end.
Revenue growth over the program.

overview.challenge: For a logistics app, the app store is the storefront — and a 3.4 rating is a closed door. Lion Parcel needed more installs without more media spend: pure organic growth, earned in the store itself.
overview.solution: A five-month app store optimization subscription working with organic traffic only: visual and textual metadata optimization, a reviews-and-ratings improvement program, and a full revision of the app's search semantics core.
overview.result: Organic installs grew 31%, revenue grew 20%, and the store rating climbed from 3.4 to 4.8. The result earned its own budget: Lion Parcel went on to increase its performance-channel investment 2.1×.

approach.title: Metadata optimization
approach.desc: Visual and textual store assets — icons, screenshots, titles, descriptions — optimized for both conversion and search.

approach.title: Reviews & ratings
approach.desc: A structured program to grow review volume and lift the rating, taking the store score from 3.4 to 4.8.

approach.title: Semantics core revision
approach.desc: The app's keyword foundation rebuilt so Lion Parcel surfaces where its customers actually search.

approach.title: Compounding results
approach.desc: With the store converting, organic installs rose 31% and revenue 20% — and the client scaled performance-channel budgets 2.1× on the back of it.
